title: Ensuring Foster Parents Gain Access to Relevant Education Information of Children under Their Care
what_it_is: Ensuring Foster Parents Gain Access to Relevant Education Information of Children under Their Care

sections.label: Sharing education information with foster parents
sections.summary: Schools share education information about children in foster care with foster parents, often via the Parents' Gateway app or other means.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Schools work with relevant agencies and foster parents in accordance with the Children and Young Persons Act to share all relevant education information about the child or young person under the care of foster parents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Where possible, foster parents are given access to all such information through the Parents' Gateway app.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: However, in selected cases, such information will be conveyed through other means, including meetings, emails or hardcopy letters.

sections.label: School communication with foster parents
sections.summary: Schools work with MSF and social workers on communication and support, and will work with foster parents if in the child's interest.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Our schools typically will work closely with MSF and assigned social worker on the appropriate way for communication as well as support for the foster parent as well as the child.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: On the suggestion to have a support network, certainly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We will look to MSF for such platforms where foster parents, as a community, can get better support and information.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: On communication between the school and the foster parents, certainly, if it is in the best interest of the child and, with the support as well as endorsement from the social worker supporting the case, our schools will be most willing to work with the foster parents on that.
